title: Community TypeScript SDK first slice: producer-verified resource-loop operations
objective: Deliver the first Community TypeScript SDK package (@mc-plan/community-sdk@0.1.0-alpha.2, private, local pack only) on the locked community.yaml 0.1.0-alpha.2 contract and the MCP-F2-COMMUNITY-001 producer evidence (community 70e55a1 + runtime image a4654b59fb48), exposing only producer-verified operations with typed ProblemDetails, abort/timeout and bounded key-stable idempotent retries.
in_scope: New sdk/community package mirroring the sdk/typescript discipline: openapi-typescript deterministic generation from the in-repo locked openapi/community.yaml with committed raw generator output and .prettierignore exemption for src/generated and dist

SUPPORTED_OPERATIONS limited to producer-verified operations; SUPPORTED_PRODUCER_COMMIT anchored at community 70e55a1; SUPPORTED_CONTRACT_FILES embedding sha256 of every generation-input contract file

Injectable baseURL/fetch/user token provider (no OIDC flow handling), typed ProblemDetails, AbortSignal and configurable timeout, bounded idempotent retry rules mapped to per-operation contract idempotency (GET plus Idempotency-Key commands; retries never rotate the key)

Unit tests covering path/error/retry boundaries per exposed operation, pack:check clean-project strict-tsc consumption, real HTTP smoke against the fixed producer image mc-plan-community:mcp-f2-community-001-779803e
Contracts docs sync (STATUS/development-plan/api-catalog Community SDK section)
out_of_scope: Any change to community.yaml, JSON Schemas or lock files (contract zero drift, proven by generate:check and validate_contracts.py)
Any write to the mc-plan-community repository (producer evidence is read-only)
Q-009 moderation provider / Q-002 formal license decisions, npm publishing, stable version numbers
Claiming any real consumer has integrated the SDK (stabilization requires a separate real-consumer acceptance workflow)
acceptance_evidence: SDK gates green: format:check, lint --max-warnings 0, strict typecheck, generate:check zero drift, vitest, build, pack:check clean consumer, smoke:real exit 0 twice against the fixed image
validate_contracts.py pinned venv and redocly three-document lint pass with contract files byte-unchanged

Real HTTP smoke scenarios: upload session lifecycle with real signed S3 PUT, list/download pagination determinism and sha256/Content-Type byte assertions, typed negative problems (401/403/404/400/409), per-operation success regression
